description: Persisted local state for one slack-manager-ai-helper topic. Version v1 stores run history with each run owning its evidence, model outputs, and memory.

version.description: Persisted-state format version. Version v1 stores nested run records.

topicId.description: Topic id this state file belongs to. It must match the loaded config to prevent mixing state between topics.

runs.description: Append-only execution records for this topic.

items.description: One CLI execution record with nested artifacts.

dateRange.description: Optional inclusive local-date range requested for an explicit run.

startDate.description: Inclusive local start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: Inclusive local end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

run.description: Execution metadata and nested artifacts for one CLI run.

id.description: Unique run id generated when the run starts.

topicId.description: Topic id from the config used for this run.

configHash.description: Stable hash of the raw config used for this run.

startedAt.description: ISO-like timestamp captured when the run started.

finishedAt.description: ISO-like timestamp captured when the run finished.

errorMessage.description: Error message stored when the run failed.

executionMode.description: Whether the run used an explicit date/window or an implicit run-derived window.

requestedRange.description: Date range requested by the user for explicit runs.

scanStartCursor.description: Exclusive lower Slack timestamp cursor used for the scan, or null when scanning from the beginning.

anyOf.description: No lower cursor; scan from the beginning.

scanEndCursor.description: Inclusive upper Slack timestamp cursor frozen at run start, or null when no upper cursor is available.

scanStartedAt.description: ISO-like timestamp captured when the scan window was established.

scanEndedAt.description: ISO-like timestamp captured when the run finished scanning and analysis work.

inputMessageCount.description: Number of Slack messages scanned from slacrawl for this run.

matchedMessageCount.description: Number of scanned messages matched by deterministic matchers after date filtering.

evidenceMessageCount.description: Number of evidence messages selected for model input.

modelCalled.description: Whether this run called the LLM.

memories.description: Memory records produced by this run.

items.description: One stored memory snapshot or update.

modelOutputs.description: Model outputs produced by this run.

evidenceMessages.description: Evidence messages used by this run.

items.description: One Slack evidence message used in the run.

memory.description: Persisted memory content extracted from model output.

topicId.description: Topic id this memory belongs to.

scope.description: Memory scope, such as global, channel, user, or action.

scopeId.description: Optional id for scoped memory, or null for global memory.

anyOf.description: Scope-specific id for channel, user, or action memory.
No scoped id for global memory.

content.description: Memory text to provide as context to later model calls.

createdAt.description: ISO-like timestamp when this memory was stored.

runId.description: Run id that produced this memory.

modelOutput.description: Stored raw model output and optional validation details.

runId.description: Run id that produced this model output.

topicId.description: Topic id this model output belongs to.

outputText.description: Raw text returned by the model.

reportText.description: Extracted markdown report section when present.

outputJson.description: Parsed JSON memory/output object when present.

schemaValid.description: Whether parsed JSON output satisfied the prompt schema, null when no validation was run.

anyOf.description: Validation result for parsed JSON output.

schemaErrors.description: Ajv validation errors for parsed JSON output when validation failed.

modelProvider.description: AI SDK provider id for the model that produced this stored report when the output can be summarized by one provider/model.

modelName.description: Provider-specific model name that produced this stored report when the output can be summarized by one provider/model.

modelAttempts.description: Total number of analysis model calls needed to produce this stored report, including retries and earlier fallback-chain attempts.

modelCalls.description: Per-segment model execution metadata for calls that produced this stored report.

items.description: One successful model call that contributed to the stored report.

usage.description: Provider-reported token usage for the model call or aggregated calls that produced this output.

createdAt.description: ISO-like timestamp when this output was stored.

modelCall.description: Model execution metadata for one successful report-producing analysis call.

segmentId.description: Model input segment id for segmented runs; omitted when not available.

provider.description: AI SDK provider id used for this report-producing call.

model.description: Provider-specific model name used for this report-producing call.

attempts.description: Number of analysis model calls needed before this call produced valid output, including retries and earlier fallback-chain attempts for this segment.

modelUsage.description: Token usage reported by the model provider for this stored output.

inputTokens.description: Total input tokens reported by the provider.

outputTokens.description: Total output tokens reported by the provider.

totalTokens.description: Total input plus output tokens reported by the provider.

reasoningTokens.description: Reasoning output tokens reported by the provider, when available.

cachedInputTokens.description: Cached input tokens read by the provider, when available.

inputTokenDetails.description: Detailed input-token breakdown reported by the provider.

noCacheTokens.description: Input tokens that were not served from cache.

cacheReadTokens.description: Input tokens read from provider cache.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Input tokens written to provider cache.

outputTokenDetails.description: Detailed output-token breakdown reported by the provider.

textTokens.description: Visible text output tokens reported by the provider.

reasoningTokens.description: Reasoning output tokens reported by the provider.

raw.description: Raw provider usage payload, when available.

evidenceMessage.description: Redacted Slack message included as model evidence.

id.description: Stable evidence id in run-id:index form.

runId.description: Run id that used this evidence.

topicId.description: Topic id this evidence belongs to.

channelId.description: Slack channel id containing the message.

messageId.description: Slack or slacrawl message UUID when available.

ts.description: Slack message timestamp used for ordering.

threadTs.description: Slack thread timestamp when the message belongs to a thread.

userId.description: Slack user id of the sender when available.

text.description: Redacted message text used as model evidence.

source.description: Why the message was included as evidence.
